item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:30 AM 12 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Albay(Malinao, Tiwi, Polangui, Oas, Libon, Jovellar, PioDuran, RapuRapu), #CamarinesSur(Buhi, Sagñay, IrigaCity, Ocampo, Tigaon, Baao, Nabua, Bato, Pili, NagaCity, Tinambac, Goa, Minalabac, Milaor, Bula, Balatan, Calabanga, Bombon, Magarao, Canaman, Camaligan, Gainza), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, Castilla, Bulusan, Juban, Irosin, Casiguran, Magallanes, PrietoDiaz, Gubat, Barcelona), #Masbate(Palanas, PioV.Corpuz, Esperanza, Uson, Dimasalang, Milagros, Mobo, CityOfMasbate, Baleno, SanFernando, Batuan), #Catanduanes(SanMiguel, Virac, Bato, Baras, SanAndres, Gigmoto and Caramoran) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(CityOfLigao, Guinobatan, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Manito, LegazpiCity, SantoDomingo, Daraga, Camalig, Bacacay), #Masbate(Placer, Cawayan and Cataingan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
